chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī, from Abī Ṭālib ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ṣalt, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr and Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from more than one of our companions, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
If something comes out of the deceased after he has been shrouded, and it reaches the shroud, that part is cut away from the shroud.

key_terms.قُرِضَ: was cut away or trimmed off
key_terms.يُكَفَّنُ: is shrouded in the burial cloth
key_terms.ٱلْكَفَنَ: the shroud used for the deceased

ai.seo_question: What should be done if the shroud of a deceased person is soiled after kafan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the shroud of the deceased after kafan. If something exits the body after shrouding and soils the kafan, the affected portion of the shroud is to be cut away.
